verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web-search API SaaS, so a data-export-and-leave story is a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents no account-level export of user data in open formats and no offboarding path. The per-request usage logs and usage-details endpoints are adjacent API telemetry, not a data-export capability. The markdown output format applies to extracted web content, not to the user's own data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
